summary: User lost access to an Ethereum wallet account after reinstalling Ledger Live on a new laptop. The wallet recovery phrase restored only an empty Ethereum account while the funded address remained visible on the blockchain. Community discussion suggested derivation path mismatch or forgotten passphrase caused the inaccessible account.
user_mistake: failed to document wallet derivation path or passphrase
prevention: document derivation paths and wallet configuration details/test full wallet recovery process before wiping devices
